displayTitle: Askeladden and the Troll in the Forest (English Retelling)
description: A faithful English retelling of the classic Norwegian folktale, keeping the original’s brisk, cunning humor as Askeladden outwits a forest troll with quick thinking, bold bluffing, and a knapsack trick.
summary: A clever youngest son bluffs and tricks a troll to win treasure and save his family from debt.
